빌려다 줬어요.es: lo pedí prestado y te lo traje
빌려다 줬어요.en: I borrowed it and I brought it to you.

사다 주세요.en: Buy it and bring it to me, please.

주셨어요.es: me lo dio, me lo trajo
주셨어요.en: He gave it to me, he brought it to me.

texto: **V-아/어다(가) 주다** presents an action whose result or object is taken to another place to deliver it to someone. It is used with verbs that allow such displacement: **사다 주다** (buy and bring / give), **가져다 주다** (carry and deliver). In the face of another action, it is often omitted.
도서관에서 책을 **빌려다 줬어요** = pedí el libro prestado en la biblioteca y te lo traje.

**V-아/어 주다** expresses to do something for someone else. **V-아/어다 주다** adds the route or transfer of the result to the recipient. **사다 주세요** usually asks to buy it and take it to the recipient; **사 주세요** asks to buy it in favor, without highlighting the transfer. The specific context of destiny.
커피를 **사다 주세요** = cómpreme el café y tráigamelo.
